532031.name: Leg Laser
532031.description:
Fires lasers from back legs, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
The back legs can be destroyed.

532033.name: Squid Missile
532033.description:
Fires many Squid Missiles at a single Nikke, dealing damage.
Missiles can be intercepted.

532034.name: Big Leg Smash
532034.description:
Kraken vigorously waves its front legs, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
The front legs can be destroyed.

532036.name: Focus Laser
532036.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

532037.name: Hydro Cannon
532037.description: Kraken inhales the surrounding seawater and shoots it out, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

532038.name: Vertical Screw
532038.description:
Stirs up a whirlwind, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Kraken generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Vertical Screw. While the barrier is up, only Wind Code Nikkes can deal damage.

532039.name: Tidal Wave
532039.description: Kraken stirs up massive waves. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals damage to all Nikkes.
